title: Materials Project
description: Documented public computational materials database (Lawrence Berkeley National Lab / DOE) for the Material Genesis Engine capability area.
body:
Materials Project is a documented computational materials database from Lawrence Berkeley National Lab / DOE. The flagship computed materials database: 150,000+ inorganic compounds with DFT-computed properties, phase diagrams, and battery-electrode data, free via API.

How it works: It works by applying the linear rule of mixtures: the composite property is the fraction-weighted sum of the component properties.

Documented uses of this capability area include alloy design for aerospace, metamaterial antennas and cloaks, composite airframes, and failure-life prediction for critical structures.
